response: The Training and Placement Cell at MGM CoET works to provide students with career opportunities, placement assistance, industry interaction, training, and recruitment support. For complete training and placement information, visit https://mgmnoida.org/training-placement/

The Training and Placement Cell supports students through training and career-development activities designed to improve their professional skills and prepare them for recruitment opportunities. For more information, visit https://mgmnoida.org/training-placement/

MGM CoET's Training and Placement Cell facilitates interaction between students and recruiting organizations and supports the recruitment process for eligible students. For details about recruiters and placement activities, visit https://mgmnoida.org/training-placement/
